evidence: The chemical binding states, thermal stability and electrical characteristics of the films grown were investigated using XPS, XRD and capacitance–voltage and leakage current–voltage analysis. The thicknesses of the grown films were measured using ellipsometry (MX75/100 T) at a wavelength of 370–1000 nm. The compositions of the films were analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) with Al Kα radiation. An X-ray diffractometer (XRD) with Cu Kα radiation was employed to investigate the crystalline properties of the films. For the electrical characterizations, capacitance–voltage (C–V) measurements were performed at a high frequency (1 MHz) using a HP 4275 multi-frequency LCR meter.
